title: FatterPlay
tagline: Pick a game. It installs, it launches, and your save follows you.
what: One app for every game in the house, old consoles and PC alike. It runs on two open-source library apps, Playnite and RomM, plus my own layer that does the installing, the launching and the saves.
built: Wrote the extension that installs a game the moment you pick it, then launches it
Saves that follow you between devices, switched on for the whole library at once
Netplay setup for playing with friends
27 native PC ports, picked and added to the library
credit: Built it, on top of Playnite and RomM

making.problem: Games were spread over a dozen systems and devices, and a save made on the TV stayed on the TV. Picking up in bed on the handheld meant starting over.
how: Playnite is the shelf you browse; RomM holds the library on the home server.
My extension installs a game the moment you pick it, then launches it.
A hook runs before and after every game, pulling your save down and pushing it back up, so every game gets save sync without being set up one by one.

proof.caption: The home screen: keep playing, play with friends.

credits: Install, launch, save sync, netplay and ports: me
